aboutText: Eley Property Maintenance is a family-owned business based right here in Heidelberg, looking after homes, gardens, and investment properties across Melbourne's North-East. From Northcote terraces to Templestowe acreage to Balwyn heritage gardens, our work covers ecological gardening services and CFA-compliant gutter cleaning. Every job comes with genuine local knowledge of your soil, your council rules, your seasonal timing, and your street.
servicesText: We deliver ecological gardening and CFA-compliant gutter maintenance across Heidelberg and Melbourne's North-East, treating every property with the care a central-roster crew simply cannot match.

services.title: Ecological Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Sustainable garden care tailored to your soil type, local climate, and native plant requirements across Melbourne's North-East.

services.title: CFA-Compliant Gutter Cleaning
services.desc: Thorough gutter clearing and cleaning that meets Country Fire Authority standards, protecting Heidelberg homes from bushfire risk.

services.title: Investment Property Care
services.desc: Reliable ongoing maintenance for landlords and property managers keeping investment properties across the North-East in excellent condition.

services.title: Heritage Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Specialist care for established and heritage gardens in suburbs like Balwyn and Northcote, preserving character and seasonal beauty.

services.title: Acreage & Large Property Upkeep
services.desc: Full-service grounds maintenance for larger properties across Templestowe and surrounding areas, from mowing to mulching.

services.title: Seasonal Garden Programmes
services.desc: Scheduled seasonal care including pruning, fertilising, and planting timed specifically for Melbourne's North-East conditions.

reviews.text: Eley Property Maintenance did a brilliant job on our Heidelberg Heights garden. They really understand the local soil and seasonal timing — our garden has never looked better. Highly recommend their ecological approach.
reviews.name: Craig McKenzie

reviews.text: We use Eley for gutter cleaning across several of our Northcote investment properties. They are CFA-compliant, always on time, and genuinely know each property. Reliable and professional every visit.
reviews.name: Simone Delacroix

reviews.text: The team at Eley looked after our heritage garden in Balwyn beautifully. They understood the character of the property and worked with the established plantings rather than against them. Fantastic local knowledge.
reviews.name: Tom & Jenny Huang
